mentions.name: HAR Analyzer
mentions.description: A native macOS app for searching and inspecting HAR files locally, without uploading sensitive traffic to the cloud, positioned as an alternative to Network Dev Tools with a better UX.
mentions.problem: Inspecting HAR files with existing tools can require uploading sensitive traffic to the cloud and involves a worse UX.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building HAR Analyzer: a native macOS app for searching and inspecting HAR files locally, without uploading sensitive traffic to the cloud.

Like Network Dev Tools but with a better UX.
